userFacing.summary: Root cause of the Export-to-PDF abort: the nonexistent setJobSavingURL: selector (a print-settings dictionary key) raised NSInvalidArgumentException on every macOS export since C-61; the save target now goes through the dictionary, the job runs modally like the print panel, and a selector-audit test pins every AppKit call this module makes.
